note: CSS migration ratchet (css-migration-plan.md). These numbers may only go DOWN. A rise is a regression; a fall means this file is stale and must be lowered in the same commit — the intention is that progress can never be spent silently. `info` is context and is not compared: a legitimate feature adds rules and lines, so those are not ratcheted. One deliberate raise is recorded here: Phase 2 split `panel.css` into the family sheets, which made the legacy classes part of the owned sheets, so `unprefixedClasses` jumped from 35 to 180 in that commit — they come down in Phase 3's rename. `panelCssLines` is now 0 because `panel.css` no longer exists.
